question: Which mantra should be employed at the conclusion of the worship, O supreme goddess?
premises: The conclusion of worship is specified.
A root mantra of twenty-five syllables is named.
The instruction is addressed to the supreme goddess.
inference: At the end of worship, one should use the twenty-five-syllabled root mantra.
plain_english: At the end of worship, O supreme goddess, use the twenty-five-syllabled root mantra.
